name: Counter Loop Pattern
problem_solved: Counting the occurrences of elements matching a specific condition in an iterable.
when_to_recognize: How many items meet condition X?
conceptual_explanation: Initializes an integer count at zero, iterates through items, and increments by one upon each match.

complexity.justification: Visits each element in the sequence once while maintaining a single integer register.

common_pitfalls: Forgetting to initialize counter before the loop
